launch_server_sglang: launch the SGLang LLM server with a specified model path and skip tokenizer initialization
wait_for_server_ready: wait for the SGLang server to be ready at the given localhost URL
get_tokenizer_for_model: get a HuggingFace tokenizer for a given model path
encode_prompts_to_tokens: encode a list of text prompts into token ID lists using the model tokenizer
send_token_input_for_generation: send tokenized input and sampling params to the /generate endpoint and decode the output
